title: Role editor & member assignment — Console RBAC v2 UI flows
creator: Marco Chen
description: Design and ship the RBAC v2 role editor and member-assignment flows inside Redwood Console. Goals: provide a clear, discoverable UI for creating and editing roles; make it trivial for org admins to assign members and groups to roles; surface audit and SSO group-sync status; prevent accidental privilege escalations; and enable safe gradual rollout of role changes. This ticket covers high-fidelity screens, interaction specs, copy, accessibility requirements, and handoff notes for engineering and PM. Work explicitly coordinates with backend APIs for permissions schema (ENG-3310) and audit events (ENG-3321).
acceptance_criteria: Role editor modal exists and supports: name, description, role template selection, granular permission toggles grouped by domain (Inference, Models, Billing, Console Admin, Dedicated).
Permission matrix shows effective permissions with read/execute/manage columns and hover explanations. Changes are previewable before save and show a list of impacted API routes.
Member assignment flow supports: invite by email, assign existing org members, sync with SSO groups, and bulk-add via CSV.
Audit links: role changes and member assignments have deep links to relevant audit log entries and show last modified by/time in header.
Safety checks: confirmation modal for changes that grant Admin-level privileges and an optional 'require approval' toggle for orgs with compliance needs.
Accessibility: all controls keyboard-focusable, screen-reader labels for complex permission toggles, color contrast meets AA, and control states programmatically announced.
Design tokens and responsive rules included; handoff artifacts (Figma + spec) uploaded and engineering acceptance review completed.

decisions: Use a modal-based role editor for quick edits and a full 'Role details' page for advanced audit/history and assignment logs.
Permission matrix will be read/execute/manage columns with a tertiary 'inherit' state to support template-based roles.
SSO group mappings will be visible on member-assignment panel with a sync status badge and last-synced timestamp.
Add an 'impact preview' panel that lists affected API routes and example actions before saving changes.
Introduce role templates (Viewer, Editor, Inference-Operator, Billing-Admin) to accelerate common setups; templates are editable (creating derived roles).

notes: Trade-offs: compact matrix reduces scroll but hides long permission descriptions; we prioritize a hover/tooltip and 'impact preview' to compensate. Bulk member assignment increases risk of accidental exposure; mitigation: CSV dry-run preview and 'require approval' workflow for orgs with compliance tag. Rollout plan: feature flag behind 'rbac_v2_ui' with targeted rollout to 10% of orgs, escalate to 100% after 2 weeks and SLO metrics look stable.
handoff: Figma file + interaction spec uploaded. Exported tokens and CSS vars included in spec file. Engineering handoff meeting scheduled 2026-03-11. PRD link in 'links'.
audit_considerations: Every create/update/delete for roles and member assignments must emit audit events with: actor_id, actor_email, org_id, role_id, change_delta, timestamp. UI will render a link to the canonical audit entry; security requested event names prefixed with 'rbac.role.'
accessibility_considerations: Keyboard-first interactions for matrix cells, aria-describedby for hover tooltips, announce permission changes on save, explainers for screen readers. Color and contrast checks completed for all proposed states.
engineering_notes: Eng dependencies: ENG-3310 (permission API), ENG-3321 (audit ingestion). Frontend work scoped into two tickets: ENG-3399 (modal + matrix), ENG-3400 (member assignment & CSV import). Provide mock API responses in the design spec.
